description:
An interactive workshop inviting residents and visitors to reimagine the public spaces around them using art and simple architecture techniques.

Open to children, families, and older residents, the workshop encourages intergenerational dialogue, bringing together youthful imagination and lived experience to explore the community's creativity.

events.name: Workshop: Reimagining Play in London's Green Spaces
events.notes: Open to children, families, and older residents. Children must be accompanied by a parent or guardian at all times during the workshop.

facilities: Handrails on both sides of stairs

factsheet.heading: Reimagining Play in London's Green Spaces
paragraphs: Join us to create the places where you live, learn, and play! Reimagining Play in London's Green Spaces is an interactive workshop for families where you can share your ideas for playful outdoor spaces in the heart of London and learn how to develop simple design concepts using art and basic architectural techniques.
Be part of a team that creates a playful installation for a public space. We'd love to hear and explore the community's creative ideas.
Set between NLA's two scale models of London, the workshop invites you to imagine yourself as a planner, inspiring you to rethink and reimagine the spaces between buildings.

travel_info: Additional travel info: The workshop will be held at The Main Gallery on the ground floor of The London Centre, between NLA's two scale models of London.

name: Reimagining Play in London's Green Spaces
